rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Analyzes smart contracts deployed on Base L2 for security vulnerabilities. Checks source code verification, detects risky function selectors, identifies proxy patterns and delegatecall usage, and evaluates contract age and transaction history. Produces a risk score from 0-100 with actionable assessments.
